input: Find general day camps, Parks & Recreation camps, summer childcare, YMCA and Boys & Girls Club summer camps and summer programs for kids and teens in or near Hendersonville, Flat Rock, Etowah, Horse Shoe, Laurel Park, Zirconia and Saluda, NC (Henderson County). Search the web thoroughly (several searches with different wording and town names) and list every organization you find.
searches: Hendersonville summer camp 2026 YMCA Boys Girls Club recreation

candidates.name: YMCA of Western North Carolina
candidates.note: Discovery day camps and Henderson County Adventure Camp; Adventure serves ages 9–15 at the Hendersonville Y.

candidates.name: Boys & Girls Club of Henderson County
candidates.note: Supervised summer programming for children and teens; summer 2026 attendance is documented.

candidates.name: Henderson County Parks & Recreation
candidates.note: Summer day-camp offerings include sports, outdoor recreation and themed activities; 2026 volleyball camps offered morning sessions.

candidates.name: Camp Tekoa
candidates.note: Elementary Day Camp ages 6–8 and Adventure Day Camp ages 9–11, plus overnight programs; summer 2027 announced.

candidates.name: Kanuga
candidates.note: Weeklong day camps for rising grades 1–6 at the Bob Campbell Youth Campus, plus Camp Kanuga and Camp Bob overnight programs.

candidates.name: Discovery Trails Learning Academy
candidates.note: Children’s summer camps combine outdoor skills, nature, science and arts; preschool camp registration also offered.

candidates.name: Grace Lutheran Church of Hendersonville
candidates.note: Preschool summer camp runs Tuesday–Thursday, late May through August, 8:30 a.m.–1 p.m.

candidates.name: Hands On! Children's Museum
candidates.note: Staff-supervised full-day summer 2026 camps with varied hands-on learning activities.
